name: Study Notes
goal: A learner can privately capture, find and revisit learning notes.

stories.story: As a learner I can register and sign in.
stories.accept: Valid credentials open my workspace; duplicate usernames give a useful error.

stories.story: As an owner I can create, edit, complete and delete my notes.
stories.accept: Saved data survives reload; a different account cannot read or change it.

stories.story: As a learner I can search titles and filter completion.
stories.accept: Percent and underscore are literal; pages and filters never include another owner.

stories.story: As a learner I can assign known tags.
stories.accept: Only python, api and database are accepted; duplicates and unknown names are rejected.

stories.story: As a learner I get recoverable failure feedback.
stories.accept: Invalid input, failed requests, expired sessions and partial tag saves have explicit behaviour.

stories.story: As a reviewer I can run and verify the application.
stories.accept: README, tests, source, container checks and a separate public-host checklist are supplied.

write_policy: Server confirmed writes; note and tags are separate transactions; edits currently use last successful write wins.
auth_policy: Fifteen-minute bearer sessions in tab memory; explicit server logout revokes one login.
